purpose: Predeclared v59 validation allocation. Creating this plan does not authorize or imply that any games were run.
engine: kaggle-environments 1.32.7 (verify exact installed version before a run)

kaito_v13_local.basis: Internal local-only executable benchmark; preserve attribution and scope in docs/V58_OPEN_AGENT_SOURCES.md. Never adapt, submit, publish, or redistribute.

ahmed_v43.status: EXCLUDED: source audit found embedded action-tape material attributed to third parties and explicitly left payload unmaterialized/unrun; execution rights for this use are unresolved. Revisit only after clear permission.

teacher_dev_spent.use: Already consumed by v59 teacher data collection and screens; never reuse for validation.

rule_route_dev_spent.use: Conservatively mark the 957xx route-rule development range occupied; later 958xx and 959xx ranges have separate reservations.

fresh_validation.use: New evaluation stages only; audited against repository seed ledgers on 2026-09-26 and not previously allocated.

pre_final_paired_screen.use: 30 fresh seeds x both seats against 8 historical + frozen reset + Kaito v13; reserve until candidate clears the small dev gate.

sealed_final_holdout.use: Final only after a byte-frozen candidate clears pre-final gate; do not run, inspect, tune against, or use for diagnostics before then.

legacy_spent: 95400-95499 may be allocated by prior branch records
seed_ledger.collision_rule: Do not allocate from 95500-95519 or 95700-95799 for these validation stages. Track any additional teacher/rule development seed before spending it. 95800-95829 is reserved for the paired panel, 95900-95914 for the development validation stages, and 93000-93049 remains sealed. Never silently recycle a previously run seed.

smoke.gate: Zero candidate errors/timeouts/incomplete games and loader success; diagnostic only.

historical_gate.gate: Zero errors and exactly 10/10 strict candidate wins for each historical opponent (five seeds, both seats).

stronger_dev_gate.gate: Zero errors; >=95% strict wins overall; >=90% per opponent and seat; seed-block bootstrap 95% lower bound >=90%. This is a small promotion screen only.

paired_pre_final.gate: Zero errors; strictly >95% strict wins overall; >=90% against every opponent and in each seat; whole-seed-block 95% bootstrap lower bound >=90%. Also publish exact errors, candidate-seat splits, 95% Clopper-Pearson intervals, coin margins, and all shop schedules. A pass is local-panel evidence only.

final_holdout.status: SEALED; do not run until historical gate and pre-final gate pass, all artifacts/engine/opponents are frozen, and the user explicitly requests final validation.

metrics.outcome: Strict wins only; draws and any error are non-wins. Report wins/losses/draws separately.
metrics.uncertainty: Exact two-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson binomial intervals and 20,000-replicate percentile bootstrap resampling whole seed blocks; report the RNG seed. Bootstrap opponent-specific and seat-specific rates as descriptive strata.
metrics.shop_report: For every game, retain replay and report the ordered, first-unlocked town shop sequence with day/step. Group scores and win rates by first shop and by observed shop-set signature; label these post hoc strata exploratory, not causal.
metrics.errors: Keep candidate, opponent, infrastructure, timeout, incomplete-game counts, status and error text exact. Do not convert an opponent error into clean candidate evidence without separately showing it; readiness requires zero errors of every class.
